title: Days with My Stepsister
description: When his father remarries, Yuta Asamura winds up sharing a roof with his new stepsister, Saki Ayase, the hottest girl in his grade. Carrying the scars of their parents’ troubled divorces, they vow to maintain a respectful distance. But what starts as cautious camaraderie blossoms into something deeper from shared experiences. Is it admiration, familial love, or something more?

episodes.title: S1-E2A Deal and a Fried Egg
S1-E5A Late Show and the Real Deal

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: High school student Yuta Asamura begins living with his stepsister Saki Ayase and her mother due to his father's remarriage. Both Yuta and Saki, who hold cautious values regarding relationships between men and women, agree to live with an appropriate sense of distance between them.

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: At school, Yuta notices that there are some sensational rumors circulating about Saki due to her striking appearance. When he tries to talk to her about it, it quickly becomes clear that there is much more to the story than the rumors suggest.

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Yuta and Saki take turns making missteps in their new, still somewhat awkward home life together. As they reflect on these mistakes and figure out how to move forward, Saki realizes she's less and less sure how to feel about Yuta. (SubsFlix_)

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: A month has passed since Yuta and Saki started living together. As Yuta starts to understand the ambiguity of their relationship, Saki asks him for help studying modern literature. The two work together to prepare Saki for a test retake.

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Shiori invites Yuta to a late showing of a movie adaptation of a book she enjoys. Saki takes an interest and goes to the bookstore the next day, where she meets Shiori for the first time.

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Saki asks her classmate Narasaka Maaya to come over after school and help her study. Yuta decides to make dinner for a change so Saki can keep studying. Maaya helps Yuta with the recipe and then starts interrogating him about his relationship with Saki.

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Saki adjusts to her new job over summer vacation. Taichi and Akiko notice that Yuta and Saki keep calling each other by their family names. Saki senses a change in how she feels about Yuta and wonders if she should describe it honestly in her diary.

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Yuta starts to get worried about Saki and asks Akiko for advice. Akiko tells him that he should take Saki out for a break now and then, even if he has to insist. Later, when Yuta tries to talk to Saki about the pool trip with Maaya, Saki reacts harshly. (Subs Flix_)

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Yuta and Saki accept Maaya's invitation to go to the pool with a group of friends. Saki enjoys the time at one of her favorite places and is finally able to let loose a little. Then, on the way home, Saki blurts something out that leaves Yuta speechless. (Subs Flix_)

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A new school term has started, and parent-teacher meetings are on the horizon. At school, Yuta and Saki still have not told anyone that they are siblings. As their mother, Akiko wants to attend both meetings, but she worries it would expose their secret. (AzAnime)

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: When Yuta is killing time in the library, Maaya confronts him and asks if he has feelings for Saki. After the parent-teacher meetings, Saki attends the open campus event at a prestigious women's college and is confronted by a particularly nosy professor. (Subs Flix_)

episodes_data.title: Days with My Stepsister Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Saki spends time with Maaya and friends while Yuta gets to know Fujinami. In their own separate ways, Saki and Yuta start to understand the feelings connecting them... in this story of a relationship that may one day become love.
